title: lava map --json
description: AGENTS.md generated from the app's own registries: routes, services, flags, commands, middleware, packs, env vars, and a framework reference. `fingerprint` is a hash of the app's DECLARATIONS — not of the rendered file — so `--check` compares two strings and gets the same verdict on any machine, in any environment. `--check` writes nothing; the default writes and reports `written: true`. A stale map is a warn (`stale_map`), so it exits 1 from `lava map --check` and 0 from a plain `lava check`.

path.description: Absolute path to the document — AGENTS.md at the app root. Absolute because it is a path to open, the same convention `source.file` follows.

fingerprint.description: What the app hashes to right now. Environment-independent by construction: a flag's VALUE depends on the environment, a flag's EXISTENCE does not, and only declarations are hashed.

found.description: The hash the file on disk claimed as the command STARTED, or null when it was absent or carried no marker — a hand-written or pre-marker AGENTS.md reads as `(no marker)` in the problem and null here. Read before the command acts, so on a write this is the state of the file it then replaced.

fresh.description: found === fingerprint, as of when the command started. The single verdict both `lava map --check` and `lava check` report, computed by one method so the two cannot disagree. On a write this is what was true of the document the command replaced — so a first `lava map` reports fresh=false alongside written=true, meaning "nothing current was here; there is now".

written.description: Whether THIS invocation wrote the file. Always false under --check, and false when the write failed — in which case a `stale_map` problem with why=unwritable is emitted and the exit code is 1.

counts.description: What the document lists, so a caller can see the app's shape without reading the file. Keys stay stable on every exit path.

modules.description: Packs listed in app/Modules.php — enabled or not, since the document is about declarations.

env.description: Every environment variable name the app or a pack declares, plus the bare config/.env entries nothing declared.
